final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt, SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM college_counts), above_average AS (SELECT cnt, (SELECT total_cnt FROM overall_stats) as total_cnt, (SELECT avg_cnt FROM overall_stats) as avg_cnt FROM college_counts WHERE cnt > (SELECT avg_cnt FROM overall_stats)) SELECT AVG(cnt) as part1_avg_count_above_avg, AVG(1.0 * cnt / total_cnt) as part2_avg_ratio_to_total, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) as part3_avg_excess FROM above_average
